usedFor: Mailjet tracks email events, and Bolna places a call to the person through “Make a Phone Call”.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Link Clicked” in Mailjet, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A click shows real interest, so the call reaches the person while the email is fresh.

watchOut: “Make a Phone Call” rings a real person, so aim it at a narrow trigger like “Email Link Clicked”.
